page_title: LEV 0-0 MON | Bayer Leverkusen v B. Monchengladbach 27/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
90+5' Moritz Nicolas pulls off a run-of-the-mill save from a header by Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) after a cross from the side.
90+2' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) is quickest to the rebound and shoots towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
90+1' A corner kick by B. Monchengladbach is thwarted by the well prepared Matej Kovar (Bayer Leverkusen).
90+1' Shio Fukuda (B. Monchengladbach) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Good work from B. Monchengladbach as they win a corner.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

89' Unbelievable miss! Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) gets himself into a great position from the corner, but sends his header well wide of the right post from in front of goal when it was easier to score.
89' The referee signals a corner kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
88' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
87' Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle and signals a foul after Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) brought his opponent down.
84' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) got to the ball inside the six-yard box all of a sudden and slammed it towards the goal, but unfortunately hits one of his teammates instead of scoring.
84' That will be all from Jonas Hofmann who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen).
82' The attendance is 30000.
81' It's a yellow card for Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach).
80' The resulting set piece from Bayer Leverkusen is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

80' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
79' It will be a substitution. Shio Fukuda (B. Monchengladbach) is ready to enter the pitch as Florian Neuhaus walks off.
79' Gerardo Seoane has decided to make a change. Christoph Kramer (B. Monchengladbach) replaces Manu Kone.
79' Substitution. Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jordan Siebatcheu walks off.
79' Josip Stanisic (Bayer Leverkusen) cracks a shot goalwards from the edge of the box, but his radar is off and it sails well wide of the left post.
76' Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
74' Josip Stanisic (Bayer Leverkusen) is booked for saying more than Deniz Aytekin was willing to tolerate.
74' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends the corner into the box, but Moritz Nicolas intercepts it and averts the threat.
74' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner.
72' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
72' The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick.
70' Here is a change. Franck Honorat is going off and Gerardo Seoane gives the last tactical orders to Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach).
69' PENALTY APPEAL by Bayer Leverkusen, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!

69' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
68' Substitution. Nadiem Amiri makes his way off the pitch and Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on as his replacement.
66' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) has tested the patience of referee Deniz Aytekin and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
64' Nadiem Amiri (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play. Bayer Leverkusen will have a throw-in.
64' The total number of attempts is 18:4.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Robin Hack departs the field of play to be replaced by Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach).
61' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
60' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.

60' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
58' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
57' Florian Wirtz provides the assist in the box, but Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) places his shot a fraction wide of the right post.
56' Bayer Leverkusen are ruled offside.
55' Nadiem Amiri (Bayer Leverkusen) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
54' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
53' Deniz Aytekin blows the whistle, Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) is penalised for a foul.
51' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
51' Flag up against Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
49' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
47' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Deniz Aytekin had an easy-decision to make.
46' Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
46' Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+1' This was a piece of cake for Moritz Nicolas. Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Good clearance! Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
43' Josip Stanisic (Bayer Leverkusen) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
43' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) makes a strong challenge and Deniz Aytekin blows for a foul.
40' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
40' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post.
39' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from B. Monchengladbach.
37' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
35' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
34' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) commits a foul and Deniz Aytekin immediately signals a free kick.
32' Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach) slams the ball towards the middle of the goal, but it fails to surprise Matej Kovar and he's equal to it.
32' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
29' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
27' The shot by Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Matej Kovar.
27' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Matej Kovar easily deals with the threat.
27' One of the Bayer Leverkusen players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
25' Good team movement sets up Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post.
25' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
24' Bayer Leverkusen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
24' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
23' B. Monchengladbach fail to score from a corner as Matej Kovar (Bayer Leverkusen) leaps to collect the ball.
22' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) strikes the ball towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes an easy save. He should have scored that.
22' Bayer Leverkusen concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player.
21' Deniz Aytekin has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach).

19' What a great effort! Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the left post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
18' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save.
18' Surely that's handball by one of the B. Monchengladbach players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
18' Bayer Leverkusen can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

18' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick.
16' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
16' The free kick is delivered by Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
16' Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) trips an opposition player and Deniz Aytekin signals a foul.
15' The ball is behind the touchline and Bayer Leverkusen will take a throw-in.
12' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

12' Josip Stanisic (Bayer Leverkusen) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bayer Leverkusen.
10' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
8' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
7' Good clearance! Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
5' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
5' Nadiem Amiri (Bayer Leverkusen) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Moritz Nicolas stops the ball from going into the top of the net.
5' A pass into the penalty area from Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted by the defence.
4' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a clever chip pass, but one of the defending players comes up with a timely interception.
3' Josip Stanisic (Bayer Leverkusen) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Bayer Leverkusen will have the kick-off.
Deniz Aytekin is the one to supervise the game today.
